_about: The moves and Ravi's lines, shared by every version (macOS, Linux, Windows). Every move works seated or standing at a desk, with no floor and no kit, so it fits an office, a library or home. Edit here, then reinstall.

moves.name: Chin tucks
moves.desc: Slide your head straight back, like you're making a double chin. Hold for a beat.
steps: Sit tall and look straight ahead.
Glide your chin straight back. Don't tip your head down.
Hold for 3 seconds and feel the back of your neck lengthen.
Let go slowly and repeat.

moves.name: Thoracic extension
moves.desc: Hands behind your head, arch back over the top of your chair.
steps: Scoot to the back of your chair so the backrest meets your mid-back.
Lace your fingers behind your head, elbows wide.
Lean back over the backrest and look up. Keep your hips down.
Come back to upright and repeat.

moves.name: Walkaround
moves.desc: Get up and walk a lap. Refill your water. Rest your eyes.
steps: Stand up and leave the screen behind.
Walk a lap of the floor, the hallway or the kitchen.
Refill your water on the way.
Roll your shoulders a few times before you sit back down.

moves.name: Shoulder blade squeeze
moves.desc: Pull your shoulder blades back and down, as if you're pinching a pencil between them.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms bent at 90°.
Draw your shoulder blades together and down.
Hold for 5 seconds without shrugging.
Relax and repeat.

moves.name: Doorway chest stretch
moves.desc: Forearm on a door frame, step through until you feel it across your chest.
steps: Stand in a doorway (or at the edge of a wall or bookshelf) with your forearm on the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step the same-side foot forward.
Turn your chest away gently until you feel a stretch.
Hold 30 seconds, then switch sides.

moves.name: Neck side stretch
moves.desc: Ear toward your shoulder, then add a light pull with the same-side hand.
steps: Sit tall and let one shoulder drop.
Tilt your ear toward the other shoulder.
Rest that hand on your head for a light pull. No yanking.
Hold 20 seconds, then switch sides.

moves.name: Stand and reach
moves.desc: Stand up, reach both arms overhead and grow tall. Lean a little to each side.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and stretch tall.
Lean gently to one side, then the other.
Lower your arms slowly.

moves.name: Seated twist
moves.desc: Sit tall, turn your chest toward the backrest, hold, then switch.
steps: Sit tall with both feet flat on the floor.
Turn your chest to one side and hold the backrest.
Breathe out and turn a little further. Hold 5 seconds.
Return to centre and switch sides.

moves.name: Wrist and forearm stretch
moves.desc: Arm straight, palm out, gently pull your fingers back. Then palm down.
steps: Hold one arm out straight, palm facing away.
Use the other hand to ease the fingers back.
Hold 20 seconds, then turn the palm down and press the hand gently.
Switch arms if you have time.

moves.name: 20-20-20 eye break
moves.desc: Look at something about 6 metres away for 20 seconds. Blink a few times.
steps: Look away from the screen.
Find something at least 6 metres away, out of a window if you can.
Keep your focus there for 20 seconds.
Blink slowly a few times before you look back.

moves.name: Hip flexor stretch
moves.desc: Step one foot back, tuck your hips under and feel the front of the hip open.
steps: Stand and take a long step back with one foot.
Bend the front knee a little and tuck your pelvis under.
Feel the stretch at the front of the back hip. Hold 30 seconds.
Switch legs.

moves.name: Calf raises
moves.desc: Stand up, rise onto your toes, lower slowly. Hold the desk if you need to.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hands on the desk.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lower slowly over 2 seconds.
Repeat.

moves.name: Chair angels
moves.desc: Back against the chair, arms in a W. Slide them up into a Y without shrugging.
steps: Sit tall with your upper back against the backrest.
Bend your elbows into a W, hands at head height, shoulder blades down.
Slide your arms up into a Y. Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.
Pull back down into the W, squeezing low between your shoulder blades. Repeat.

moves.name: Levator scapulae stretch
moves.desc: Nose toward your armpit, then let your hand ease your head down. For the tight spot where neck meets shoulder blade.
steps: Sit tall and hold the side of your seat with one hand to anchor that shoulder.
Turn your head away from that side and look down toward your other armpit.
Rest your free hand on the back of your head and let its weight add a gentle pull.
Hold 20 seconds, breathing out slowly, then switch sides.

moves.name: Shoulder rolls
moves.desc: Shrug up, squeeze back, drop down. Slow, backward circles.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms loose.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back, drawing your shoulder blades together.
Let them drop all the way down, then go round again.

moves.name: Seated cat-cow
moves.desc: Hands on your knees. Round your back as you breathe out, lift your chest as you breathe in.
steps: Sit near the front of your chair, feet flat, hands on your knees.
Breathe out and round your back, tucking your chin and pelvis.
Breathe in and roll your pelvis forward, lifting your chest and gaze.
Move slowly between the two and keep it pain-free.

moves.name: Seated figure-4 stretch
moves.desc: Ankle over the opposite knee, sit tall and hinge forward until you feel it in your seat.
steps: Sit tall and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Let the crossed knee drop open. Flex that foot.
Keep your back long and hinge forward from your hips until you feel the stretch in your seat.
Hold 30 seconds, then switch legs. Back off if you feel a pinch in the hip.

moves.name: Seated hamstring stretch
moves.desc: Edge of the seat, one heel forward with the toes up. Hinge forward with a long back.
steps: Scoot to the front edge of your chair.
Straighten one leg, heel on the floor, toes pointing up.
Hands on your thigh, keep your back long and lean forward from your hips.
Stop at a gentle stretch behind the thigh. Hold 30 seconds, then switch.

moves.name: Sit-to-stands
moves.desc: Stand up from your chair without using your hands, then sit back down slowly.
steps: Sit near the front of your chair, feet hip-width apart and under your knees.
Lean forward a little, reach your arms out and stand all the way up.
Sit back down slowly, taking about 3 seconds, and just touch the seat.
Repeat. Make sure your chair won't roll away.

moves.name: Desk push-ups
moves.desc: Hands on the edge of a sturdy desk, feet back. Lower your chest, then push away.
steps: Check the desk is sturdy and won't slide or tip.
Hands on its edge a little wider than your shoulders, walk your feet back.
Keep your body in a straight line and lower your chest toward the desk.
Push back up. Repeat.

moves.name: Tendon glides
moves.desc: Fingers straight, hook, full fist, open again. Keeps the tendons gliding after a lot of typing.
steps: Hold your hands up, fingers straight and together.
Bend only the top two finger joints into a hook. Knuckles stay straight.
Curl into a full fist, thumb on the outside.
Open back to straight. Hold each shape for 2 to 3 seconds.

moves.name: Brügger relief position
moves.desc: Edge of the seat, knees wide, arms out with your palms forward. Lift your chest and breathe.
steps: Sit at the front edge of your chair, knees wide, feet turned slightly out.
Let your arms hang beside you and turn your palms forward, thumbs pointing back.
Lift your chest, draw your shoulders back and down, and tuck your chin a little.
Hold 10 seconds while breathing into your belly. Relax, then repeat.

moves.name: Belly breathing
moves.desc: Hands on your belly. In through your nose for 4, out slowly for 6. Silent, so it works anywhere.
steps: Sit tall and rest your hands on your belly.
Breathe in through your nose for about 4 seconds and feel your hands move out.
Breathe out slowly for about 6 seconds. Keep your shoulders still.
Repeat for 6 breaths.

moves.name: Ankle pumps
moves.desc: Under the desk: toes up, toes down. Gets the blood moving in your calves. Nobody will notice.
steps: Sit with your heels on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins.
Point them down and press the balls of your feet into the floor.
Keep a steady rhythm. Add a few ankle circles each way at the end.

off: I check on you every few minutes once you start. Press P.
Nonna's orders: you sit up, I keep the time.
running: Your spine is not a croissant.
I'm stuffed with ricotta and I still sit straighter than you.
Al dente posture: firm, not stiff.
Screen at eye level. I can see you squinting.
Feet flat on the floor, please.
Breathe out. You've been holding that since lunch.
Twenty minutes is a long time to be shaped like a prawn.
paused: Taking a break from me? Rude, but fine.
Paused. I'll be right here, judging gently.
meeting: Shh. I'll wait until your meeting's over.
Look attentive. I'll hold your stretch.
held: One stretch is waiting for when your meeting ends.
skip: Skipped. I'll pretend I didn't see that.
back: Welcome back. Fresh clock from now.
You moved, I noticed. Clock starts over.
